title: Regulating the expression of matrix metalloproteinases to inhibit ovarian carcinoma using isoquinoline alkaloid from Allium ascalonicum.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物生物碱与MMP蛋白的分子对接和MD模拟，但对象是蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及转录因子或结合位点预测，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Ovarian carcinoma is one of the fatal gynecological cancers due to the lack of clinical symptoms at earlier stages of disease leading to metastasis and lower survival rates. Hence, an in-depth exploration of the mechanisms of metastasis facilitates the development of novel-targeted therapeutic strategies to treat the disease. Research studies have reported that three predominant Matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs), namely, MMP14, MMP2 and MMP9 can induce the migration of ovarian cancer cells, Epithelial-Mesenchymal transition, breakdown of extracellular matrix, upregulation of expression of transcription factors etc. in the microenvironment of ovarian tumors. In our current research, these predominant MMPs were used as target proteins and docked with potential anti-cancerous phyto-nutraceuticals present in Allium ascalonicum species. Allium ascalonicum, commonly referred to as Shallots is being used in various cuisines worldwide and is still largely unexploited for its anti-cancer properties. Docking results, revealed three potential phyto-nutraceuticals, of which, 1-[[3,5-bis(phenylmethoxy)phenyl]methyl]-6-methoxy-2-methyl-3,4-dihydro-1H-isoquinoline, an isoquinoline alkaloid was considered the best, since it exhibits significant binding affinity when compared to that of the standard drug, Melphalan. Molecular dynamic simulation studies exhibited that MMP2 is highly flexible and can form more stable interactions. Furthermore, simulation studies of finest interaction pose of the target MMPs with the best phyto-nutraceutical, revealed stable interactions and occurrence of conformational changes. The results, also suggested that, the best phyto-nutraceutical of Allium ascalonicum is a novel isoquinoline alkaloid, with favorable bioavailability scores that interact with target MMPs to control the progression and metastasis of ovarian cancer, proposing the prospect of formulating it into sustainable medications for treating metastasized Ovarian Cancer.
abstract_zh: 卵巢癌是一种致命的妇科癌症，由于疾病早期缺乏临床症状，导致转移和生存率降低。因此，深入探索转移机制有助于开发针对该疾病的新型靶向治疗策略。研究报道，三种主要的基质金属蛋白酶（MMPs），即MMP14、MMP2和MMP9，可在卵巢肿瘤微环境中诱导卵巢癌细胞迁移、上皮-间质转化、细胞外基质降解、转录因子表达上调等。在我们当前的研究中，这些主要的MMPs被用作靶蛋白，并与火葱（Allium ascalonicum）物种中存在的潜在抗癌植物营养素进行对接。火葱，通常称为青葱，在全球各种烹饪中使用，但其抗癌特性在很大程度上尚未被开发。对接结果显示，有三种潜在的植物营养素，其中，1-[[3,5-双(苯甲氧基)苯基]甲基]-6-甲氧基-2-甲基-3,4-二氢-1H-异喹啉，一种异喹啉生物碱，被认为是最佳的，因为它与标准药物美法仑相比表现出显著的结合亲和力。分子动力学模拟研究表明，MMP2具有高度灵活性，并能形成更稳定的相互作用。此外，对最佳植物营养素与靶MMPs的最佳相互作用构象进行的模拟研究，揭示了稳定的相互作用和构象变化的发生。结果还表明，火葱的最佳植物营养素是一种新型异喹啉生物碱，具有有利的生物利用度评分，能与靶MMPs相互作用以控制卵巢癌的进展和转移，提出了将其制成可持续药物以治疗转移性卵巢癌的前景。
